legal.privacyPolicy:
Umuntu okhokhela: Adrián Carrasco López. Ukuxhumana: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Inhloso: ukulawula i-invitations yoboda, ukukhawuleka kwesifika kanye nokunxibelelana ngezingxoxo. 

Isisekelo somthetho: isivumelwano somuntu (art. 6.1.a GDPR). Idatha yempilo (iziloba nezinto ezingakwaziwa ukuziphila) iqhathwa ngezivumelwano ezibonakalayo (art. 9.2.a GDPR) ukuze kuqondiswa i-menu yosuku lokubonga. 

Idatha egathwe: Uhlu lwezihloko ezilindelekayo: umkhokheli angakwazi ukweba uhlu lwezigama (izihloko ezilindelekayo) ukuze kuphathwa ukufika; leyo datha iyonakekelwa umkhokheli kuphela futhi ivame kabi ipolicy yokugcina. I-consent ebonakalayo: isivumelwano se-RSVP kanye nezinguquko zoku-cookie zigcinwa nividethi kanye nesixhobo sothando. Ukufika nokuchazwa: ngezinhloso zokuphepha kanye nokulandelelana (umthwalo omuhle), kucathwa ukuzama kokufika ku-panel lomkhokheli kanye nezinguquko zokulawula (ividethi, uhlobo lwenzenzo kanye nezibalo zokuthi yisizinda). igama, izinguquko zokudla (iziloba nezinto ezingakwaziwa ukuziphila), izithombe ezikwenziwe ngokuzivocela, idatha yezimalo uma inikezwa ngokuzivocela, idethi yokuzalwa (kupela ukuqinisekisa umfundi wezinyaka ku-RSVP yomfundi omncane), idatha yezinsiza zokukhiqiza (user-agent) lapho uqinisekisa ukufika, futhi uma uqhuba izinketho zesosiyete ze-invitation (izibonakaliso, ingoma, izindlela, ukukhetha izipho), igama lakho kanye nemisho onikezayo, okubonakalayo kubo bonke abahlobo. 

Abatholwa: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) ongenaka e-EE.UU. Google laqinisekisa i-Cláusulas Contractuales Tipo (SCC) ezihlonishwa yile Komishini ye-European (Decisión de Ejecución 2021/914) futhi inezinguquko zokulawula idatha (DPA) ngokwesakhiwo kwe-art. 28 GDPR. Ngaphezu kwalokho, Google ilandela i-Data Privacy Framework (DPF) ye-UE-EE.UU., i-UK-EE.UU. kanye ne-Switzerland-EE.UU., isitifiketi esiqinisa umthwalo wokugcinwa okufanele yizithuthi zedatha zemihla yesizwe. 

Ukuhambisana kwezithuthi zemihla yesizwe: idatha igcinwa ezinsiza ze-Google Cloud e-eur3 (Europe, Frankfurt). Lapho kudingeka ukuhambisa idatha e-EE.UU., ukuhambisa kuqondiswa i-SCC kanye ne-siti-siti ye-DPF ye-Google. 

Isikhathi sokugcinwa: idatha yizihloko igcinwa kuye ku-12 iminyaka emuva kwesikhathi se-event. Lapho isikhathi sasiyona, idatha yizihloko ikhiphelwa ngumphathi wenhlandla (owezinguquko ku-panel lakhe) futhi, ngaphandle kwakho konke, akingcinwa kude kuphela kuka-12 iminyaka. Ungakwazi ukicela ukukhiphelwa kwalo ngaphambi. Ungakwazi ukucela ukukhiphelwa kwalo ngaphambi nini ngokubhala ku-adriancl2001@gmail.com. Idatha yokulawula komkhokheli igcinwa kuye ku-12 iminyaka emuva kwesikhathi se-event noma kuze kube lapho ikawunti isebenza, okokuqala; ukukhiphelwa kwakuyona umphathi wenhlandla. 

Imempilo: ungakwazi ukusebenzisa imempilo yakho yokufika, ukulungisa, ukukhiphela, ukulawula, ukuhambisa, kanye nokukhohlisa ngokubhala ku-adriancl2001@gmail.com. Izihloko zingakwazi ukucela ukukhiphelwa kwedatha yazo zikhomba igama lazo kanye ne-invitation. Sizwamukela icelo lakho kukuphawula kweminyaka engaphezu kweminyaka engama-30. 

Isiqalo sokukhipha isivumelwano: ungakwazi ukikhipha isivumelwano sakho nini. Ukukhipha akwazange kuphazamise ukuhleleka komsebenzi okwaziwa ngesivumelwano esiqalo. 

Abantwana: akugathwa idatha yabantwana abangumfundi wezinyaka 14. Uma umuntu okhokhela umfundi omncane ongengeziwe kuye izinyaka 14 (okanye umngane omuhle ngokwesizwe: 14 eSpain, 16 eGermany, njll.), kusadingeka isivumelwano sabazali bakhe noma abazali bakhe. 

Izinqumo ezizivocayo: akukuhambisanga izinqumo ezizivocayo ezisekelwe kwitholaso yakho. 

Ukuphazamiseka kokuqinisekisa idatha: uma ungatholi idatha yakho, akwazange sikwazi ukulawula ukukhawuleka kwesifika sakho. 

DPO: lo-website akudingi iDelegado de Protección de Datos ngokwesakhiwo kwe-art. 37 GDPR ngoba akuzange kuphumelele izimo ze-art. 37.1. Noma kunjalo, ungakwazi ukuxhumana nomkhokheli nini. 

Izicelo ze-GDPR (UE/EEE): ungakwazi ukunikeza isicelo ku-Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) noma kuqhuba lokulawula komkhaya wakho we-UE. 

UK GDPR: kubantu abakhona e-UK, umkhokheli okhokhela uqinisekisa ukuziphatha nge-UK GDPR kanye ne-Data Protection Act 2018. Google ilandela i-UK Extension ku-DPF ye-UE-EE.UU., futhi i-SCC laqondiswa yi-Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) njengendlela yokuhambisa evakalisa. Ungakwazi ukunikeza isicelo ku-ICO (https://ico.org.uk). 

LGPD (Brazil): kubantu abakhona eBrazil, umkhokheli okhokhela uqinisekisa ukuziphatha nge-Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Lei nº 13.709/2018). Google ilandela izidingo zokuhambisa idatha ye-LGPD. Umphathi (DPO): umkhokheli ofanayo. Ukuxhumana: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Imempilo ngokwesakhiwo kwe-Art. 18 LGPD: ukukhawuleka, ukufika, ukulungisa, ukuzivocela/ukublokeja/ukukhiphela, ukuhambisa, ulwazi mayelana nokubandakanya, ukikhipha isivumelwano, ukubuyekeza izinqumo ezizivocayo, ukukhohlisa. 

CCPA/CPRA (California): kubantu abakhona e-California (EE.UU.), unamandalo okuthi: 
- Uyakwazi ukwazi yiziphi izinhlobo zedatha yomuntu siqu esigathwe futhi ngendlela yiphi. 
- Ucela ukukhiphelwa kwedatha yakho yomuntu siqu. 
- Ukukhetha ukungihambisi ukuthengisa idatha yakho yomuntu siqu (asithengisi idatha yomuntu siqu). 
- Ukungahlukaniswa ngokusebenza izimempilo ze-CCPA zakho. 
Ukuphatha leyo mempilo, bhala ku-adriancl2001@gmail.com. 

PIPEDA (Canada): kubantu abakhona eCanada, sithola i-Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. Izimempilo ze-PIPEDA: ukubekezela (Adrián Carrasco López), ukwakhiwa kwezinhloso, isivumelwano, ukulawula ukugathwa, ukulawula uksebenzisa/ukukhuluma/ukugcina, ukunemthethweni, ukugcinwa, ukubonakalisa, ukufika komuntu siqu, ithuba lokucela. Izenkazo zokubuhlungu ezidingekayo ku-OPC. 

POPIA (South Africa): kubantu abakhona e-South Africa, sithola i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Sigathwa idatha yakho ngezivumelwano zakho izinhloso ezithile. Izimo zokuhambisa izithuthi zemihla yesizwe (Ibhiseki 72 POPIA): idatha ihambiswa ku-Google LLC (EE.UU.) elinikeza umthwalo wokugcinwa okufanele nge-SCC kanye ne-DPF. Umkhokheli uqinisekisa ukuthi umtholwa usebenzisa izimempilo zokusebenza ezifanayo ne-POPIA. Ungakwazi ukunikeza isicelo ku-Information Regulator (South Africa). 

I-plan wokuziphatha izithuthi zokuphepha: uma kukhona ukevulwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu, Wedingo izobethelela kuqhuba lokulawula okuhle kakhulu emkhawulweni we-72 imizuzu (GDPR Art. 33). Uma ukevulwa kuphawula inkinga enkulu kubo bonke abatholwa, abazobethelelwa ngaphandle kwesikhathi eside (GDPR Art. 34). Izibethelelo zizobenzelwa nge-email ku-contact address elinikeziwe. 

Ukugcinwa okumalumele: lo-website usebenzisa ukugcinwa okumalumele. Akusizondi i-third-party cookies noma i-trackers ngaphandle kwesivumelwano sakho noma ngaphandle kwenzuzo yakho: i-map iqala ukusebenza lapho ikhwebela kuphela. Ukugcinwa okumalumele: lo-website usebenzisa ukugcinwa okumalumele (localStorage kanye ne-sessionStorage) kuphela izinketho eziyisisekelo: ukugcina isesiye sakho esivulekile kanye nokugcinwa kwezinguquko ze-invitation. Akusizondi i-third-party cookies noma i-trackers. Ngokuqhubeka nokuhamba, usemema ukusebenzisa lo-storage oludingekayo. 

Ukuhlaziya nokubekwa kwemiphazamiso: ngezivumelwano sakho (inkethe ye«Istatistika yokuya»), Wedingo isebenzisa i-Google Analytics (Google LLC) ukuze imele ukusebenzisa okungabonakali kwe-invitation kanye ne-Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., ne-DPA kanye ne-Cláusulas Contractuales Tipo) ukuze kutshaphwe futhi kutholwe iziphazamiso. Lezi zinsizakalo ziyathola idatha kuphela uma usemema leyo inkethe ku-cookie banner; akasizondi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma i-invitation ihlanganisa i-map, i-Google Maps view iqala ukulanda kuphela lapho ikhwebela kuyo (ukulanda ngaphakathi): i-map ingakwazi ukophawula i-cookies ye-Google kuphela ngalo mqondisi futhi ngenxa yenzuzo yakho. Ukuxhumana okungadingekayo: uma umhlobo uyamvumela (checkbox ethile), i-phone noma i-email yakhe igcinwa kuphela yizindlela zokuhlela isigameko futhi umkhokheli kuphela oyonakekelwa; kungakwazi ukucela ukukhiphelwa kwalo nini.

legal.cookiesPolicy:
I-platform iqhuba lolu hlelo lokugcinwa nokuqhuba: 

• Ukugcinwa okudingekayo: ikhefu lakho lolimi nokukufaneleka, kanye nesesiye sokulawula/admin (sessionStorage). Ngaphandle kwesivumelwano sakho, akukugcinwa okuhlobo lwitholaso lisebhara. 

• Ukugcinwa okumalumele (localStorage) noIndexedDB: kugcina ngesikhathi i-content ye-invitation (izibalo, izithombe, kanye ne-audio ezigcinwe nge-AES-GCM) ukuze kube lula ukulanda futhi kube khona ukulungiswa ngaphandle kwesiqalo. Kuzisetshenziswa kuphela uma usemema ukugcina; uma ukhola ukulabela, i-invitation ihlanganiswa ngendlela yesesiye (ngaphandle kokugcinwa) futhi idatha egcineva ihambeka. 

• Izinsizakalo zamaqembu (kupela ngemuva kwesivumelwano sakho): Google Analytics noSentry (istatistika kanye nokuchaza iziphazamiso). I-session replay ye-Sentry igcaca isesiye kuphela uma usemema i-analytics futhi ayigcini i-credentials yakho. 

• Izenzo ezifunwa (ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esiqalo, ngenxa yokukhweba kwakho): Google Maps ukuze kuphawule isethiwe ye-invitation. Ekusetshenziswa, idatha yakho igwenziwa kulo mqondisi ngokwezinhlelo zakhe. 

• Service worker: igcina izinsiza zokukhiqiza ezidingekayo ukuze lo-app lisebenze ngaphandle kwesiqalo, ngaphandle kwedatha yomuntu siqu. 
​
Ungakwazi ukulawula noma ukikhipha isivumelwano sakho noma nini kusuka ku-cookie notice. Isikhathi: okudingekayo yizinhloso ezichazwe (izibalo ze-invitation zikhiphelwa iminyaka 12 emuva kwesikhathi se-boda noma ngaphambi uma kucelwa).

music-spinner.hint: A wheel spins on the button while the song is loading.

music-fab-hover.name: Music button scale
music-fab-hover.hint: The floating button slightly enlarges when hovered over.

music-status-shake.name: Music error shake
music-status-shake.hint: The loading error message shakes to draw attention.

hero-photo-ring.name: Anillo dorado de la foto
hero-photo-ring.hint: Un anillo dorado pulsa alrededor de la foto de la pareja en la portada.

hero-godparent-glow.name: Resplandor de los padrinos
hero-godparent-glow.hint: The text with the groomsmen's names emits a warm, pulsing glow.

hero-photo-fade.name: Fundido de la foto al cargar
hero-photo-fade.hint: La foto de la portada aparece con un fundido suave cuando termina de cargar.

countdown-tick.name: Cuenta regresiva en directo
countdown-tick.hint: The remaining time counter updates every second. When deactivated, the static initial value is shown.

loading-spinner.name: Ruedas de carga
loading-spinner.hint: Las ruedas giratorias que aparecen mientras cargan la foto de la portada y otros contenidos.

gallery-blur.name: Cambio de foto con desenfoque
gallery-blur.hint: When navigating the gallery, the previous photo blurs while the new one enters sharply.

gallery-caption.name: Entrance of each photo description
gallery-caption.hint: The description of each photo appears with a small upward slide.

gallery-lightbox.name: Apertura del visor de fotos
gallery-lightbox.hint: The full-screen gallery viewer appears with an entrance fade.

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Escala de las miniaturas
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: Gallery thumbnails slightly enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-nav-hover.name: Gallery arrow scale
gallery-nav-hover.hint: Gallery navigation arrows enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-auto-advance.name: Automatic carousel advance
gallery-auto-advance.hint: The gallery advances from photo to photo every 5 seconds. When deactivated, it only changes when the arrows are pressed.

button-hover.name: Button elevation
button-hover.hint: The invitation buttons (RSVP, share, send...) lift slightly with a shadow when hovered over.

reaction-hover.name: Escala de las reacciones
reaction-hover.hint: The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) slightly enlarge when hovering over them.

theme-glow-depth.name: Resplandor del fondo
theme-glow-depth.hint: A glow of light slowly runs across the background of the invitation, giving a sense of depth.

landing-pulse.name: Pulso de las pantallas de carga
landing-pulse.hint: El fondo de las pantallas de carga, error y mantenimiento pulsa suavemente.

toast-animations.name: Avisos flotantes
toast-animations.hint: Los avisos breves (confirmaciones, errores...) aparecen y desaparecen con un deslizamiento.

animations.allOffHint: When activated, the invitation is displayed without any animation: the envelope does not appear, there is no confetti or transitions. When deactivated, your individual preferences return.
